name: Evaluating LLM Applications
description: A practical course on application-level LLM evaluation: turning product requirements into test cases, choosing between code checks, human review and LLM-as-judge, calibrating judges against people, running evals in CI with tools such as Promptfoo and Inspect, and closing the loop with production traces and online experiments.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Evaluating LLM Applications

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 19 lessons in 6 modules; and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 40 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
